philosophy.notes: The Moose-inspired editorial publishing feel now stays intact while the renamed identity and cover-image hero better center the portfolio as Gary's own body of work.

hierarchy.notes: Branding now reads consistently from the nav through the hero, and the toolbar adds clear search-result feedback without competing with the feed.

execution.notes: Mobile navigation now has a real accessible toggle and close behavior, interaction states remain intact, and the supporting card styling is cleaner and less template-coded.

specificity.notes: The page still uses portfolio-ready placeholders where needed, but the naming, labels, and status text now read as one coherent publishing system for instructional design work.

restraint.notes: The page keeps its quiet editorial canvas, one muted accent, and avoids generic accent-strip cards or extra decorative flourishes while gaining only functional UI additions.
